meta.title: 曙宝 (Shubao) | Community token on BNB Chain
meta.description: 曙宝 (Shubao, 슈바오) is a fan-made community token on BNB Chain inspired by the giant panda cub born in South Korea on June 3, 2026. A treasure as bright as the dawn light.

now.title: She's there now: go say hi
now.p1: Shubao lives at Panda World in Everland, Yongin, South Korea, and since October 30, 2026 she has been open to the public. On her first day, fans gathered from early morning. Viewing times are being extended step by step, so check Everland's official channels before you go.
now.p2: Today her photos and videos are everywhere: X, YouTube and every social feed. Everyone wants a look at the little dawn treasure.

story.name.title: What her name means
story.name.text: 曙 means dawn, 宝 means treasure. Together: “a treasure as bright as the dawn light”. In Korean, 새벽빛처럼 밝은 보물.
story.name.date: Her name was announced on September 11, 2026, her 100th day.
story.keeper: Her keeper describes her as curious and playful: she explores on her own and practises climbing trees.

buy.title: Get 曙宝 in four steps
buy.s1.d: Install a wallet that supports BNB Chain, such as MetaMask or Trust Wallet. Write your seed phrase down offline and never share it.
buy.s2.d: Buy BNB on an exchange and send it to your wallet on BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20). You need it for the swap and the network fees.
buy.s3.d: Go to PancakeSwap, connect your wallet and check that the network is BNB Chain.
buy.s4.d: Paste the full contract address from this page, check that the token is 曙宝 and confirm the swap.
buy.slip: If the swap fails, raise the slippage a little in PancakeSwap's settings and try again.
buy.note: Nothing on this site is financial advice.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: A fan-made community token on BNB Chain, inspired by Shubao, the giant panda cub born in South Korea on June 3, 2026. It has no intrinsic value and no promised returns.
faq.a2: No. 曙宝 is fan-made and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Everland or Samsung C&T.
faq.a3: Community takeover: no developer runs the token. Holders coordinate the project together on X and Telegram.
faq.a4: Only on this page and on @ShuBaoCto: 0x7E15837DaF327b65f571a008B2D5Dd6C5E407777. Always compare the full address.
faq.q5: Are there buy or sell taxes?
faq.a5: Check the live security report on GoPlus or Token Sniffer before trading: they read the contract directly. If a swap fails, raise the slippage slightly.
faq.a6: At Panda World in Everland, Yongin, South Korea, open to the public since October 30, 2026, and on Everland's official YouTube channels.
faq.a7: No. Crypto is highly volatile: do your own research and never invest more than you can afford to lose.
